description: Shared fixtures for compat-rules.json (schema/compat-rules.schema.json). The C++ core (native/core/src/compat_rules.cpp, run by native/core/tests/test-compat.sh) and the launcher's Rust reader (crates/kiln-manage/src/compat.rs) must give the same results. glob: a module matcher against a DLL file name. parse: one file's text (`input`: a string is the raw file text, anything else is the JSON) -> `ok` (false: the whole file is ignored), the ids of the rules that stay, in order, and `dropped` (how many rules did not validate or were past the 512-rule limit; the reasons are informative, except that `problems` (how many problem lines, default `dropped`) and `lastProblem` (its exact text) are checked when a case has them: the rules past the limit give one summary line, not one each). merge: the shipped file's rules and the player's file's rules -> the final rule ids in order. evaluate: rules (already validated) against the facts of one start -> the ids of the rules that fire, in order. facts: modules = DLL file names present, engines = engine words present, mods = `<engine>:<id>` of the enabled profile mods, symbols = sigdb symbols with an overlap.

parse.name: warn may name a subject of any kind, or none
late and disable need a subject
ids: 1-128 characters of letters, digits and . _ - :
a repeated id: the first stays
a rule with an unknown key is dropped
top level must be an object
an entry that is not an object
limits: at most 8 when matchers, wildcard module patterns of at most 64 characters and 4 *
a null subject is not a matcher
more than 512 rules: the first 512 stay, one summary says how many were ignored
parse.lastProblem: more than 512 rules: the last 2 are ignored

merge.name: the player's rule replaces in place and others are appended

evaluate.name: mod ids and symbols are exact
the engine word of a mod ignores case
native: and kiln: name the same mod
an engine is not a module
